title: I Am God (Digital Circus)
blurb: The Amazing Digital Circus landed in October 2023 and did numbers almost nobody expected: a Glitch Productions pilot about people trapped inside a garish virtual circus, watched hundreds of millions of times before a second episode existed. The dialogue escaped into meme circulation almost at once, and this grandiose declaration was one of the first lines out of the gate. Total conviction, zero supporting evidence. It suits any moment of wildly unearned confidence, from winning a single round to fixing one bug to finally getting a jar open.
origin: A line from The Amazing Digital Circus (Glitch Productions, 2023).
